key_notes: Key 1 (t=4.58s): Initial archival pose of headphones; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=5.71s): Mid-sequence articulation of headphones; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=6.94s): Peak dynamic extension of headphones over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=8.18s): Follow-through and settle of headphones with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of headphones (4.58s..8.18s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
